test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India governs the Population Census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 246**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 246** of the **Constitution of India** deals with the distribution of legislative powers between the **Union and the States**.
 
• This article divides the subject matter of laws into three lists: the **Union List**, the **State List**, and the **Concurrent List**.
 
• The **Population Census** falls under the **Union List**, meaning only the Parliament has the authority to legislate on this subject.
 
• The census in India is conducted under the provisions of the **Census Act, 1948**, which is a central legislation.
 
• The Population Census is carried out every **ten years** by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 179**__

 __
 
• **Article 179** of the Constitution of India deals with the **vacation and resignation of, and removal from, the offices of Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly**.
 
• This article specifies the procedure for the removal of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker from their positions.
 
 
 
• **Article 233**__
 __
 
• **Article 233** of the Constitution pertains to the **appointment of district judges**.
 
• The article specifies that appointments, postings, and promotions of district judges in any state shall be made by the Governor of the state in consultation with the High Court.
 
 
 
• **Article 128**__
 
 
• **Article 128** deals with the **attendance of retired Judges at sittings of the Supreme Court**.
 
• This article allows the Chief Justice of India to request a retired judge of the Supreme Court or a High Court to sit and act as a judge of the Supreme Court.
